questions.stem: Which of the following characteristic features would you expect to see in a histopathology slide of conjunctiva?

options.label: A
options.text: Amacrine cells within non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium

options.label: B
options.text: Goblet cells within non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium

options.label: C
options.text: Goblet cells within keratinized stratified squamous epithelium

options.label: D
options.text: Amacrine cells within keratinized stratified squamous epithelium
